scope: Two broad land-cover classes for an explicitly restricted development comparison; no fine material/species identity or original full-scene objective equivalence.

classes.name: exposed bare ground
classes.interpretation: Explicit coarse grouping of published Bareland-1/2 and Bare soil. Substrate, contamination, subclass balance and spatial resolution may differ; no claim of identical soil material.

classes.name: tree canopy
classes.interpretation: Published Trees/Tree at broad canopy level only, not matched species or tree age.

table_review.review: Previously rendered/read by C and independently visually agreed by D. C7 reuses that table-only review, not the GT figure.

excluded_xuzhou_ids.2: Lakes: no corresponding HongHu water class.
excluded_xuzhou_ids.3: Coals: not Bare soil or a generic ground label.
excluded_xuzhou_ids.4: Cement: not bare soil and not necessarily a road.
excluded_xuzhou_ids.5: Crops-1: no authoritative cultivar alignment with HongHu crop names.
excluded_xuzhou_ids.8: Crops-2: no authoritative cultivar alignment with HongHu crop names.
excluded_xuzhou_ids.9: Red-tiles is not automatically the object-level Red roof label.

local_mapping_evidence_level: Corroborated development mapping: original published ordinal table plus exact per-ID historical count vector, same image/GT fingerprints through the curator/release chain and matching local/provider README. Not publisher byte-identical certification of the project's derived MAT conversion.
old_names_rejected: Historical manualG3 names5=Coal/6=Cement conflict with the original table; they do not relabel any stored array or override numeric release IDs.
unlabeled_zero: Original raw0 means unannotated, not common class0. Only original labeled samples mapped by this explicit table receive common class0.
future_claim_scope: Metadata-corroborated coarse cross-scene/device few-shot development classification; independent confirmation and causal sensor effect are not admitted.
